title: From Texas Hearings to KSA Licences: iGaming Trends Shaping African Betting
flags: the first batch of online licence renewals in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA)
the Dutch Gambling Authority (KSA) had renewed eight online gambling licences as part of its five‑year renewal plan
African regulators—such as the National Lottery Regulatory Commission in Nigeria or the Kenya Gaming Board—might look to KSA’s model when updating their own licensing regimes
Q: How does the KSA licence renewal impact African operators?
It sets a benchmark for licensing standards. African regulators may adopt similar measures, which could affect operator compliance and market offerings.
